commits.summary: Record the setup of the Spring P01-P30 brief so far
commits.body: First part of the mechanical setup for llm-dlc/loops/spring-framework-pr-links-p01-p30-brief.md: all 61 pinned spring-framework revisions fetched into the shared mirror and checked out as worktrees (every PR merged, merge commit = after pin, landed diff = PR files, 21 signed pins verify), 23 Gradle distributions and a Liberica 17 verified against their publishers' checksums, and the finding that the seven Spring 5.x checkouts cannot be configured because their build scripts need plugins no public repository serves (propdeps-plugin, spring-asciidoctor-extensions, gradle-enterprise-conventions 0.0.2). For those, released Spring jars whose changed sources match the pins were found by blob comparison and resolved with their dependencies (sha1s all match). Online dependency resolution of the 6.x and 7.x worktrees is still running; build jobs follow.

commits.summary: Queue the Spring 6.x setup builds of the P01-P30 brief (verification pending)
commits.body: Eight setup jobs, one per Spring 6.x case of llm-dlc/loops/spring-framework-pr-links-p01-p30-brief.md (P20, P21, P22, P24-P28): each builds the case's jars offline at both pins with the Gradle and JDKs the checkout names, runs the landed test classes at each pin, keeps jars, class digests and classpaths, runs the fix's test files on a copy of the parent (where they should fail or not compile) and cleans up. Dependencies were resolved online first (both passes, no pass-1 failure) and the offline task graphs dry-run cleanly. The setup record gains the snapshot-dependency digests (P20's Reactor/Micrometer snapshots are their last builds of 2023-02-13/14) and the job layout.

commits.summary: Queue the Spring 7.x setup builds of the P01-P30 brief and rerun P25 (verification pending)
commits.body: Fifteen setup jobs for the Spring 7.x cases of llm-dlc/loops/spring-framework-pr-links-p01-p30-brief.md (P01-P04, P06-P08, P10, P12-P15, P17, P29, P30), the same four steps as the 6.x ones (offline build and landed tests at both pins, artifacts and classpaths kept, the fix's tests on the parent, clean), after online resolution of all 31 7.x worktrees and clean offline dry-runs. The record gains the 6.x results: seven of eight jobs passed, every transplant failing or not compiling as expected (named tests per case). P25's job failed because its landed test class is abstract with nested subclasses that --tests did not select; the case now uses ProxyExceptionHandlingTests* and is resubmitted.
